name: core--live-scripts-commonjs-module-scope
description: Every script under tools/home-assistant-live/ is CommonJS: ha_ws_util.js ends in `module.exports = { connectWs, rest }` and each apply_*/validate_*/investigate_* script consumes it with require(). On 2026-09-19 the monorepo root gained /Users/krasi/koeff-gitroot-main/package.json with "type": "module" for the workflow engine. Node resolves the nearest package.json upward from a file's own directory, and tf-home-lab has none, so that root declaration silently reclassified every .js in this repo as ESM. Under ESM the `module.exports = ...` assignment is inert, so require() of the helper yields an empty namespace and every consumer dies with "rest is not a function". This was found on 2026-09-23 while diagnosing a live climate complaint: no live inspection, patch or validation script in this repo had been runnable for four days, including validate_logic.js, which makes the repo's own eval regression suite unrunnable. Fix is a repo-local package.json declaring "type": "commonjs", which restores the pre-2026-09-19 semantics without touching the root file the workflow engine depends on.

changes: New tf-home-lab/package.json declaring "type": "commonjs", private, with no dependencies and no scripts - its only job is to stop the monorepo root's "type": "module" from reaching this repo's .js files

Nothing else changes: no file renamed to .cjs (which would break every require() path and every README/doc reference), and the root package.json is left untouched because the workflow engine requires ESM

checks: require() of tools/home-assistant-live/ha_ws_util.js returns both exported names, not an empty object
A representative consumer script loads and runs against live Home Assistant without the 'rest is not a function' TypeError
validate_logic.js --all runs to completion, which was impossible while the repo was treated as ESM
The monorepo root package.json is unmodified, so the workflow engine's ESM resolution is unaffected
Node resolves the repo-local package.json rather than the root one for files under tools/
evidence: C2: node tools/home-assistant-live/apply_manual_override_ac_calibration.js (dry run) reached live HA and reported 'already applied - no-op' for all three rooms, 'dry run - 0 automation(s) would change'
C3: node tools/home-assistant-live/validate_logic.js --all ran all 12 suites to completion (018-029)
C4: git status on the monorepo root package.json is clean; it still declares "type": "module"
C5: the repo-local package.json is the nearest one above tools/, so Node resolves it first

notes: The eval suite's failure set after the fix is pre-existing and unrelated: 018 3/8, 019 4/6, 021 2/4, 024 5/6, 025 1/3, 028 2/5, 029 4/5. 020, 022, 023, 026, 027 pass.

029 C-fresh fails on sensor.miaomiaoce_t2_5249_temperature at 21.1h > 5h (bedroomb primary, battery 10%). That is a dead battery in the field, independently corroborating the same-day owner report, not a code regression.

Detection latency: four days. Nothing in the repo runs these scripts on a schedule, so an ESM reclassification in a sibling repo silenced the entire live-tooling surface without any signal. A cheap smoke check that requires ha_ws_util.js and asserts both exports would have caught it on 2026-09-19.
